observations: The implementation rounds inputs containing fractional cents to the nearest cent; the stated cent-based contract does not define fractional-cent handling.
reasoning: For cent-denominated Decimal totals, divmod guarantees base * ways + extra equals the original cent count. Exactly extra earliest elements receive one additional cent, the returned list has exactly ways Decimal elements, and ways < 1 raises ValueError. No blocker-level defect survives scrutiny.
